test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 12 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The Competition (Amendment) Bill, 2022 belongs to ____ Ministry of India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Corporate Affairs.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Competition (Amendment) Bill, 2022** aims to amend the **Competition Act, 2002,** which falls under the purview of the **Ministry of Corporate Affairs.**
 
• **The Ministry of Tribal Affairs** primarily deals with matters related to the welfare and development of tribal communities in India.
 
• **The Ministry of Finance** is responsible for the management of public finances, fiscal policy, and economic policy in India.
 
• **The Ministry of Law and Justice** is responsible for the formulation of legal policy and drafting of legislation in India.
 
• **The Competition (Amendment) Bill, 2022** is related to the regulation of competition in the market, which is primarily under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Corporate Affairs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Ministry of Tribal Affairs was created in 1999 to address the unique needs and challenges faced by tribal communities in India.
 
• The Ministry of Finance is one of the most important ministries of the Government of India and is responsible for the management of the country's finances.
 
• The Ministry of Law and Justice is responsible for the administration of justice and the development of legal institutions in India.
 
• The Competition Act, 2002 was enacted to promote competition in the market and to prevent anti-competitive practices.

***Hence, the statement "The Competition (Amendment) Bill, 2022 belongs to the Ministry of Corporate Affairs of India" is correct.***
